Team — quick internal huddle notes after Olivia's email (excerpted below). Procurement is in a freeze until 12/07; security wants SOC2 artifacts. They are concerned the evaluation plan will slip and that will cascade the go-live beyond their quarter.

Proposed immediate plan (to present to customer):
1) Scope freeze: move non-critical integrations and the advanced reranking eval out of the MVP. Keep text generation, embeddings, and audit-log export for now.
2) Phased acceptance: acceptance band 1 (pilot core features) on Dec 15, band 2 (integrations) on Jan 15. This keeps a visible go-live date for some runway.
3) Commercial backstop: we can commit to a one-month credit (to offset processing delays) but we need Marissa to approve up to $20,000 in discretionary credit for this account.
4) Security: offer SOC2 artifact packet plus a 30-min walkthrough; ask Laura to schedule with their security contact for tomorrow.

Risks to flag in the risk log: procurement freeze -> slip > 2 weeks; security review -> unknown hold; capacity decision late -> may require Dedicated pool provisioning which has a 3-week lead if we need GPUs reserved.

If Marissa approves the credit and Ben can draft a short amendment for procurement, we can finalize MAP and push it to the customer by 3pm PT today.

Thanks,
Karthik
